<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Double, Double](/Feats.aspx?ID=5009) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Witch" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=734" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 189

**Prerequisites**
[Cauldron](/Feats.aspx?ID=4993)

</column>

---

For each temporary oil or potion you brew during your daily preparations, you brew two copies of it. This allows you to brew two temporary oils or potions each day, four if you have master proficiency in spell DC, or six if you have legendary proficiency
name: Double, Double
